decision: GO for CUDA preflight fix; NO-GO for training, metrics, pilot launch, Shiny Blender Real, metric changes, or quality-improvement claims.

fixed_preflight_design.auto_selection_policy: A candidate GPU is accepted only after nvidia-smi idle check passes and a fresh torch CUDA subprocess preflight passes.
fixed_preflight_design.explicit_device_policy: If nvidia-smi is unreliable but an explicit physical device is requested, execute-mode jobs may proceed only after the fresh torch CUDA subprocess preflight passes for that physical device.
fixed_preflight_design.torch_import_order: torch is imported only inside a fresh child process after CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES is present in the child environment

previous_false_negative.interpretation_after_manual_verification: The previous no-launch CUDA gate is treated as a runner preflight false negative, not proof that the environment lacks CUDA.
previous_false_negative.observed_previous_gate: ref_gs PyTorch runtime reported torch.cuda.is_available() false and device_count 0 for checked candidates when probed by the old runner path.
